jurisdiction.name: Bolivia
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Bolivia has no AI law, AI strategy, AI guidance or data protection law. The only adopted instrument that addresses AI is the Agenda Digital 2030, approved by Supreme Decree 5367 of 2025, which includes an initiative to build a public-sector AI data model with data governance and regulatory instruments. Two AI bills are pending in the legislature, one of which would create an AI regulator, and a UNESCO AI readiness assessment began in August 2026.
lead_institutions: Agencia de Gobierno Electrónico y Tecnologías de Información y Comunicación (AGETIC)
narrative.review_notes: Reviewed on 12 October 2026 and re-checked on 18 October 2026, when the Official Gazette could be searched and showed no AI-specific laws or decrees; the Senate's legislative records and individual ministry sites could not be fully searched. The pending AI bills, the UNESCO readiness assessment and the planned AI data governance model are tracked as leads.

instruments.english_title: Digital Agenda 2030 (approved by Supreme Decree No. 5367)
instruments.issuing_authority: President of the Plurinational State of Bolivia in Council of Ministers (Supreme Decree No. 5367); prepared and monitored by AGETIC
instruments.current_status: Approved as the annex of Supreme Decree No. 5367 of 2 April 2025, published in the Official Gazette of the Plurinational State of Bolivia (edition 1883NEC, publication date 2025-04-02); the decree applies to the Executive (ministries, dependent entities and public enterprises) and charges AGETIC with monitoring and evaluation. No repeal or replacement found on official sites as of 2026-10-18. It is a general digital-transformation agenda; AI appears as one initiative (12.1.1) under Pillar 12 'Gobierno inteligente'. Bolivia has no national AI strategy; pending AI bills (see leads) would task AGETIC with drafting one.
instruments.summary: Bolivia's digital-transformation agenda to 2030, approved by Supreme Decree No. 5367 and binding on the planning of the central Executive, with five axes (infrastructure and connectivity, technologies for life and Mother Earth, digital government, digital economy, digital governance) and 18 pillars of specific objectives and initiatives assigned to lead ministries. Under Pillar 12 'Smart government' it commits to developing a general data model for artificial intelligence in the public sector, including data governance and regulatory instruments (initiative 12.1.1), and to promoting automated assistance for citizens and smart technologies in municipal management. AGETIC monitors implementation and is to set up a Digital Transformation Observatory.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only government-approved planning document that sets an AI objective for the public sector (AI data model, data governance and regulatory instruments); AI is a minor component of a broader digital agenda.

leads.title: Proyecto de Ley PL-CS-N°178/2024-2025 "Promoción, Gestión y Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial"
leads.english_title: Bill on the Promotion, Management and Use of Artificial Intelligence (Senate bill 178/2024-2025)
leads.issuing_authority: Plurinational Legislative Assembly (Chamber of Senators; now in the Chamber of Deputies)
leads.note: Senate bill (exposición de motivos at https://apisi.senado.gob.bo/images/9e4c0190-a4d1-4806-aab3-25e72c2a26b9_1740492809.pdf proposes an AI Regulatory Authority 'ARIA'). Passed by the Senate in October 2025 (press reports only) and sent to the Chamber of Deputies; on 27 April 2026 a deputy requested its reinstatement ('reposición') for the 2025-2026 session (scanned letter and file at https://diputados.gob.bo/leyes/pls-no-178-2024-2025/ , PDF https://diputados.gob.bo/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/PL-CS-178-2024-2025.pdf, 11 scanned pages, not OCR-read). Pending; not enacted as of 2026-10-12. Press reports say it would give AGETIC 180 days to draft a national AI strategy (unverified in the bill text). Update 2026-10-18: the Chamber of Deputies bill page (https://diputados.gob.bo/leyes/pls-no-178-2024-2025/) still carries only the scanned file; no enacted law found in the Official Gazette search; still pending.

leads.title: Proyecto de Ley N° 558/2024-2025 / PL 310/2025-2026 "Ley General de Inteligencia Artificial"
leads.english_title: General Artificial Intelligence Law bill (Chamber of Deputies bill 558/2024-2025, reinstated as PL 310/2025-2026)
leads.note: Submitted 11 June 2025 by deputies Mariela Baldiviezo Castillo and Gustavo Aliaga Palma (received 17 June 2025, https://diputados.gob.bo/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/PL-558-2024-2025.pdf); reinstated on 4 March 2026 as PL 310/2025-2026 at the request of deputy Salma Tobías Paz and sent to the Planning, Economic Policy and Finance Committee (https://diputados.gob.bo/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/PL-310-2025-2026.pdf). Scanned PDFs; only cover letters read. Pending. Update 2026-10-18: bill page https://diputados.gob.bo/leyes/pl-no-310-2025-2026/ unchanged (scanned PDF only); no enacted law found in the Official Gazette search; still pending.
